verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a public developer API. It has OAuth 2.0 auth, read/write endpoints with a reference, a Batch API for asynchronous multi-operation requests, and specific endpoints such as creating approvals and updating attachments. An llms.txt index of the developer docs is live (HTTP 200), which supports AI-native consumption. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Call the [API endpoints](/reference) to read and write Wrike data.
Implement [OAuth 2.0](/docs/oauth-20-authorization) to securely access user data.
The Batch API lets you execute multiple operations asynchronously in a single request to reduce API calls and rate-limit pressure.
